# Reward prediction error learning in the mesolimbic system

## Overview

The VTA and the nucleus accumbens form a learning loop.

## HCD

`VTA` signals the reward prediction error and `NAC` stores state values.

## Limitations

Laterality of the prefrontal input is simplified.

## References

- [Schultz, 1997] Schultz W, Dayan P, Montague PR. Science 275:1593.
